title: Harvest Season
description: Gives every composter a pumpkin-like design as well as a randomly rotated face. With optifine it'll have a bunch of randomized faces! :D
body:
This pack is pretty simple, only changing one block but giving it too many models so it has all kinds of rotations and sports a random face. Mainly just for whenever you wanna get into the fall spirit, or just wanna for some reason have every composter you have.

You are completely free to make an extension of this pack for any other pack you'd like to slap it onto. I'd rlly love to see what people can do with it. :D

(Just don't republish this and call it your own please.)
